en: "Y-you there~!{w}Please, help me calm my horse down~!!"{w}
Dullahan
"Waaah, somebody~~~!"{w}

"Phew~~, thank you so much.
You really helped me out with all sorts of stuff.{w}*bow*"{w}
note: pekori = bowing sound effect, rendered *bow*

en: With that, the girl tipped her severed head downward.{w}
note: source names her shoujo (girl); bowing with the head she carries

en:
"This little one's called Coiste Bodhar,
but it's been all worked up since this morning."{w}{p}"You mustn't go causing everyone trouble, okay?"{w}
note: kosutabawaa = Coiste Bodhar, the Dullahan's coach/horse in Irish folklore; NEW NAME. Second quote is said to the horse

en: The horse just turned its head away.{w}

"But I've got this uneasy feeling too, you know.{w}Is just taking back that Palace of the Sun really going to fix everything, I wonder..."{w}{p}"Hmmm...{w}Oh well, whatever."{w}{p}"I'd better get going.{w}I've got my job of splashing buckets of blood on everyone's houses, too~"{w}{p}"I owe you one.{w}Thank you kindly! *bow, bow*"{w}
note: blood bucket = Dullahan folklore (douses those who open their door); arigatou deshita is cutesy-ungrammatical, kept light

en: *  The wind enveloped you  *{0F}{w}
note: source has {0F} with no {0E} in this row; kept verbatim
area-title banner; full-width padding replaced by ASCII spaces (44-col lines, title centred) like slice_003 banners

en: Friendly Spirit
"You made it all the way up here!{w}Color me surprised!"{w}

"For wingless folk to make it this far...{w}...I'm speechless.{w}Welcome to the Castle of the Wind."{w}{p}"And the one who dwells at the summit is the master of the Castle of the Wind."{w}{p}"Don't you even think of going up there.{w}That is not someone who would ever deign to deal with the likes of you."{w}
note: akireru = taken aback/exasperated -> speechless

en: Wind Spirit
"...Creatures from below, is it.{w}Begone, before the wind casts you out and dashes you against the earth."{w}
Dragon
"Why are denizens of the world below in this place?{w}This Castle of the Wind is no place for the likes of you to set foot."{w}{p}"Leave at once."{w}
Before you stands a woman wearing a hood.{w}{p}She is most likely the woman Hanoi spoke of.{w}
note: Hooded Woman (as in wmap slice_19); Hanoi not gendered

en: "Oh, hello.{w}What brings you adventurers all the way out here?"{w}
She was a woman with a truly mysterious air about her.{w}{p}Under her gaze, you were seized by the feeling that she could see into the very depths of your heart.{w}

"Looks like you're in some kind of trouble.{w}If you don't mind it being me, why not tell me about it?"{w}{p}"I might be able to help, you know.
Fufu."{w}
note: fufu as in Hisbert/Hooded Woman lines in wmap slice_19/20

en: You told the woman about Rafa{w}and that you were looking for a way to save Rafa.{w}
note: source says kare (him) for Rafa; glossary gender unknown, so name repeated instead of a pronoun

en: "Hmmm..."{w}

note: jaaku na majutsushi-san = Zaalhaut, rendered "my dear wicked mage" as in wmap slice_20 1533; Ruu/Makakuri spellings from wmap slice_19 1513

en: With that, she held out her hand to you.{w}{p}A mysterious light enveloped you.{w}
Agintaitus
"What business do little ones have in this Castle of the Wind?{w}I have no business with those who know nothing of this land's history. Leave at once."{w}
note: chiisaki mono = little ones (dragon addressing the party)

en:
"What business do little ones have in this Castle of the Wind?{w}I have no business with those who know nothing of this land's history. Leave at once."{w}{p}"...Hm? That box...!
Is that... the Sun Prison Shrine?{w}Why would little ones have such a thing..."{w}{p}"Little ones,
where did you obtain that?{w}That is not a thing to be handled lightly."{w}{p}"...Hmm... Miasuna... the Meiroin...{w}I see... Little ones, you could hardly know
what that object truly means..."{w}{p}"Little ones, since it has come into your hands,
you must learn the reason it was made.{w}Because you dwell upon this land, that is why."{w}{p}"...When this land,{w}Rainal Manoza, was forsaken by the gods,
there was one who was sacrificed to save it..."{w}{p}"That one was chosen from the fairy village,
became the Sun Spirit with the aid of a sage,
and saved Rainal Manoza from collapse."{w}{p}"But there was a fairy who grieved over it..."{w}{p}"That fairy became the Moonlight Spirit
and kept watch over the Sun Spirit ever after.{w}...The two of them were lovers."{w}{p}"...I watched it all unfold from beginning to end,
together with the sage."{w}{p}"That doll is the fairy's form from before becoming the Sun Spirit.{w}...It must have been kept tucked away with great care."{w}{p}"Little ones, you must never forget this tale.{w}Hold it firmly in your hearts."{w}
note: first page repeats row 1533 verbatim (same JP). NEW TERMS: youro no zushi = Sun Cage Reliquary (key item; box holding a handmade fairy doll, SCD10), Miasuna (place, castle of a Demon Duke per MON_TEXT), Meiroin (meirouin, building in Miasuna, romanized). sono mono (the sacrificed one) kept neutral. The sage = Zaalhaut (row 1577). "It must have been kept" left subjectless: JP does not say who kept the doll (likely Yorfa)

en:
"Little ones.{w}Never forget the tragedy of those two,
the Sun Spirit and the Moonlight Spirit..."{w}
Figure (Center)
note: nazo no jinbutsu chuuou = mysterious figure, centre; pre-reveal name box for the Ryug

en:
"Have you not learned!?
So you too would invade our land!"{w}
note: shoukori mo naku = undeterred by others' failures

en: Figure (Left)
"This land belongs to us, the Ryug.{w}We will never hand it over to the likes of you."{w}
note: Ryug spelling from wmap slice_20 1534; used as the people's name (uninflected plural)

en: Figure (Right)
"This land is not where you will find healing.{w}Withdraw."{w}
Somehow, you managed to drive off the Ryug.{w}Then you told them that you had heard about this land from Hisbert.{w}
Destroyer Ryug
note: hakai no Ryuugu = Ryug of Destruction; NEW short name-box form

en: "...The honored Hisbert..."{w}
note: dono honorific -> "the honored" (gender-neutral)

en: Shield Ryug
note: tate no Ryuugu = Ryug of the Shield

en: "It must mean the situation has grown that dire.{w}The power of the Dark Realm has certainly become something we cannot ignore."{w}
note: an'iki = Dark Realm (wmap slice_20 1526)

en: Healer Ryug
note: iyashi no Ryuugu = Ryug of Healing

en: "But this land has only just been born.{w}Even our power has its limits."{w}
"Even so, we must drive them back.{w}This is our land, the land of the chosen!"{w}
note: "them" = the Dark Realm's forces (row 1546)

en:
"......{w}You were told by Hisbert to come to this land."{w}{p}"That means fighting the forces of the Dark Realm.{w}If the librarian of the Elminage System says so,
our own power must not be enough..."{w}{p}"Galling as that is."{w}
note: Elminage System / librarian as in wmap slice_19 1474

en:
"No... Then we just stay like this...
unable to do anything..."{w}

"Nonsense! Then why are we here!?
Are you saying the gods have abandoned us!?"{w}
note: kami (no number in JP) -> "the gods" (the world has the Six Gods of Creation)

en:
"I don't know... But they are here.{w}Their power, strong enough to drive back even us...
That must be what Hisbert saw in them."{w}
"Adventurers.{w}This land now stands under threat from the Dark Realm."{w}{p}"Would you be willing to save this land with your strength?"{w}

"Envoys of the honored Hisbert or not,
borrowing the strength of otherworlders...
Do you mean to sully the pride of the Ryug!?"{w}{p}"Besides, can they truly be trusted?
These creatures of a lower race?"{w}
note: kisama addressed to Shield Ryug; katou shuzoku = lower race (wmap slice_19 1488)

en:
"Then we should simply perish as we are?{w}I have no intention of indulging that drivel
about the beauty of a noble end."{w}
note: horobi no bigaku = aesthetics of ruin

en: "What did you say!?!"{w}

"Stop it, both of you.{w}Then here is what we shall do."{w}{p}"It is true that we face a crisis.{w}And it is just as true that there are things we cannot manage on our own."{w}{p}"But however strong they may be, they are a lower race.{w}We are the Ryug, the chosen people."{w}{p}"So, how about this plan?{w}We will have them defeat those detestable Demon Dukes for us."{w}{p}"And then have them bring back proof of it."{w}
note: NEW TERM: daimakou = Demon Duke(s) (rank of the Kin of Darkness; many named ones in MON_TEXT)

en: "Hmm... If it is that, then..."{w}
"Very well."{w}

"Toiling away, are we, lower race?
Is the burden too heavy for the likes of you?"{w}
note: gokurou da (condescending) said while the quest is unfinished

en:
"And yet it is also true
that we must borrow that lower race's strength."{w}

"That's enough. We will be right here.
We'll be waiting for good news."{w}
"Well done, lower race!{w}Just what one would expect of adventurers chosen by us!"{w}
"Power enough to drive back even the Demon Dukes...{w}Perhaps the word 'hero' was made for the likes of you."{w}
"Thanks to you, a time of healing will come to this land as well."{w}

"We have been saved.{w}But your own goal is not yet achieved, is it?"{w}{p}"Our power may fall short, but tell us if there is anything we can do.{w}On the pride of the Ryug, we will see your wish granted without fail."{w}
Wicked Mage
note: jaaku na majutsushi = Zaalhaut (wmap slice_20: "wicked mage")

en: "Then I'll have you grant my wish."{w}
"Who goes there?"{w}
"And you are...? Could you be that...{w}wicked mage...?"{w}{p}"It was not you who defeated the Demon Dukes, surely."{w}
note: the point: he did not earn the promised wish; literal sense kept

en: "Their goal... and you are connected to it...{w}Is that right...?"{w}

note: koyatsura = the party. NEW TERM: seisouken = Holy Genesis Sphere (dungeon with lower/middle/upper levels, SCD17)

en: "The Sanctum of Genesis? What could be in a place like that...?"{w}
"With our power it is not impossible, but what are you scheming?"{w}

"We could not make Rafa a true Sun Spirit.{w}And because of that, Rafa and
Yorfa both had to suffer so..."{w}
note: subject "we" = Zaalhaut and Agintaitus (previous row says both were unskilled)
"that land" = Rainal Manoza (they are now in the Ryug's land)

en: With that, Zaalhaut vanished.{w}
"The Sun Spirit...{w}So you too were striving to save a land."{w}
"The Dark Realm's invasion must be stopped."{w}

"If that Sun Spirit is restored, it could become a means of countering the Dark Realm."{w}{p}"That is so, is it not?
Very well."{w}
note: speaker field says Shield Ryug for both pages; kept as data says

en: "We shall send you to the Sanctum of Genesis."{w}
Go to the Sanctum of Genesis?
note: 30 chars, at the data limit

en: "When you are ready, come to us."{w}
